sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Alpha Route commenced. Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence within the area.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Wyndham Street; area thoroughly checked.
Arrived at the corner intersection of Queen and Shortland Street, all clear.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, no issues found.

Check-in at Commercial Bay; full walkthrough completed around the area ensuring no issues present. Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart and the cafes within the location, all clear. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Continuing patrols; no activities requiring our assistance.
Sweep completed along the Bus Terminal on Lower Albert Street, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Welfare check along Federal Square and The Cathedral Church; area thoroughly cleared, no issues found.
Welfare check commenced at Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Bakery, Natural Health and Barclay's Suites, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Little Albert's Coffee, Formery, Sergeant Coffee and The People's Barista, all clear.

Check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare checks completed at Amelia Cafe, Printshop, 77 Convenience Store and nearby stores, all clear. Standing by to ensure a visible presence while awaiting response calls.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street reporting a male street vagrant sleeping inside the store; assistance requested to move him along.

Arrived at the response location; asked the individual to vacate the premises per McDonald's policy that benches and chairs are strictly for customers only. He complied without any altercation. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Moving along and making our way to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Check-in at Aotea Square; full scope of the area, heavy presence from members of the public. Standing by to show security presence while awaiting further response calls. Ending Alpha Route.
Welfare check at Munster Inn and Queens Food Court, all clear.
Check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; area thoroughly cleared.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.

Response call from The Right Track reporting a male individual causing a disturbance inside the store, walking in and out of the building; staff requested assistance to have a word with him to calm him down.
Check-in at the corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear. Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses within the area, all clear.
Commencing welfare checks along High Street stores, all clear.

Arrived at the response location; the individual had already left the site and was hanging around near Wilson Carpark on Fort Street next to the public toilets. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, all clear.
Check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; welfare checks commenced on all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the last check-in.
Welfare check completed along Vulcan Lane, Lower High Street and O'Connell Lane, all clear.
Check-in at Chancery Square; full sweep completed within the vicinity, checked in on stores, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Arrived at Elliott Street; showing presence within the area while awaiting further response calls.
Arrived at HQ; taking the morning interval before heading back out.
Break concluded; continuing patrols up Queen Street ensuring a visible presence.
Welfare checks commencing along the way, checking in on stores.
Heavy Police presence at NZ Tourism School; circumstances unknown, but one male individual was seen placed in custody inside the Police vehicle. Standing by to show presence and offer assistance.
Response call from Giapo Gore Street reporting a very suspicious male vagrant standing at the phone booth; no assistance needed yet — staff will advise if further details arise.

Check-in at Aotea Square; heavy presence from members of the public, with performances and activities for the public to join. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Welfare checks commenced within Metro Entertainment City, Game On and Burger Fuel, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear.
Response call from Munster Inn reporting an aggressive female vagrant known to be trespassed from the store; immediate assistance requested.

Asked the individual to vacate the premises; reminded her that she is trespassed and no longer allowed access, and that Police will be notified if she goes against the request. Standing by to show presence.
The individual has moved along and is making her way down Queen Street.
Response call from Lumi Cafe reporting a street vagrant sleeping next to their store; request to move him along due to a strong unpleasant odour.
Arrived at the response location; asked the individual to move along and he complied without any issues.

Asked another street vagrant sitting in front of Ippondo to move along, following recent complaints from the store owner about people sitting in front of their glass window. He complied without issues.
Arrived at HQ; taking lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Response call from Cotton On reporting a group of street vagrants congregating in front of their store, smoking and getting out of control with too many sitting in front.
Arrived at the response call; asked the group of street vagrants to move along and they complied without further issues.
Morning shift completed; equipment handed over.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Maintaining presence on Queen Street for nearby response calls and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Arrived outside Avachi Chicken; welfare checks on stores between HQ and McDonald's Queen Street, all clear. Standing by maintaining a security presence for the public and surrounding businesses.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred and no response calls received.

Arrived at the bottom of Durham Street East; welfare checks on stores between HQ and Durham Street East along Queen Street, all clear. Standing by for security presence and nearby response calls (15:42–16:05).
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred and no response calls received from surrounding businesses.

Arrived at Pocket Park; welfare checks on businesses along Queen Street between Pocket Park and Durham Street East, no concerns reported. Maintained a visible security presence while monitoring for problematic individuals, vagrants and nearby response calls.
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred and no response calls received.

Arrived at Fort Street / Jean Batten Place; welfare checks on businesses within the area completed, no issues reported. Maintained security presence while monitoring for problematic individuals and vagrants.
Departed standby area; no incidents or problematic individuals observed.
Arrived at Gore Street; welfare checks on businesses within the area completed, no issues identified or reported.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare checks on surrounding businesses completed, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence for members of the public (17:00–17:35).
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred.

Arrived at the corner of Albert Street and Victoria Street West; welfare checks on businesses along Albert Street and surrounding areas, all clear. Maintained security presence for businesses and members of the public.
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at HQ to conduct floor checks.

Observed a male vagrant outside Ippondo on Queen Street; approached and instructed him to move away from the storefront due to repeated complaints about vagrants gathering outside the business. Remained on-site while the individual slowly prepared to leave.
The male individual outside Ippondo complied with security instructions and moved away. Resumed patrols.

Received a report from a member of the public regarding a scooter stolen while they were dining at Queen's Food Court. Photographs and video footage of the suspected offender were provided. Advised the complainant that security would remain alert for the person of interest and the stolen scooter, and would assist with its recovery if located. (Footage on file.)
Observed a male consuming alcohol in a public area; approached and instructed him to put the alcohol away. The individual complied without incident.

Received a response call from a member of the public reporting that a group of minors were attempting to fight an elderly individual at Bus Stop C on Lower Albert Street, near Commercial Bay Shopping Centre.
Arrived at Bus Stop C on Lower Albert Street; no minors or active altercation were observed on arrival. Relocated to TK Square to maintain a visible security presence.
Departed standby area; no further incidents occurred.
Received a response call from Wow Chicken requesting assistance with moving vagrants away from the front of their store.

Arrived at Wow Chicken and approached the male individuals outside the premises; informed them of the staff's request to move along. All individuals complied without incident. Remained in the area on standby.
Departed standby area and returned to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ; Ops Phone battery at 6%, commenced charging.
Ops Phone battery reached 37%; preparing to resume patrols.

Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street; welfare checks on the store and surrounding businesses, all clear. Maintained security presence while monitoring for problematic individuals, vagrants and other disturbances.
Departed standby area; no incidents occurred.
Arrived at Ace Karaoke due to concerns regarding the assigned security guard not arriving on time; the venue manager subsequently confirmed the guard had arrived. Remained on standby.
Departed Ace Karaoke and returned towards HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Arrived at HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Afternoon shift concluded; Auror reports processed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Night shift deployed; remained on standby while charging the Ops Phone.
Checked in at Bar 101; no major issues reported by the security guards or bar manager. Remained on standby and assisted the Head Doorman with the removal of several intoxicated patrons.
Commenced foot patrol along Queen Street; no breaches or major issues observed. The street was relatively quiet with only a few people out for the evening.
Checked in at McDonald's Britomart; no issues reported by restaurant staff or the assigned security guard.
Patrolled the Commercial Bay area; quiet, with no issues to report.
Commenced foot patrol along Quay Street and through the Viaduct area; a few people observed heading towards the Viaduct entertainment precinct. No incidents reported.
Checked in with the security team at Danny Doolan's and the Viaduct; Danny Doolan's was particularly busy, but no issues reported by venue staff or the security team.
Received a response call from Bar 101 requesting security assistance; responded immediately.

Arrived at Bar 101 and assisted the security team with removing an intoxicated patron who refused to leave the premises; the removal related to the patron's intoxication and clothing. The individual was removed without further incident.

While maintaining a security presence outside Bar 101, observed a group of intoxicated teenagers attempting to vandalise the venue's signage. Approached the group and instructed them to stop and move along; all complied without incident.
Maintained security presence on Elliott Street; pedestrian activity had decreased and no issues were observed.
Commenced foot patrol towards Fort Lane and Fort Street; both areas quiet with no incidents reported. Continued patrol towards Upper Queen Street.
Arrived at Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive; no major issues observed. A few homeless individuals were seen walking around and searching through rubbish bins.
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a homeless individual refusing to leave the premises; responded immediately.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street and approached the individual; following security instructions he complied and left the premises, crossing the road to sleep on his cardboard bedding. No further issues occurred.

Remained on standby at McDonald's Queen Street to monitor the arrival of a delivery driver transporting goods to the restaurant. The designated loading zone was blocked by traffic workers, requiring the driver to park on Wellesley Street instead; maintained security presence during the delivery.

McDonald's Queen Street all clear. Continued foot patrol towards Lower Queen Street, covering Commercial Bay, Britomart, Commerce Street, Fort Lane, High Street and Wyndham Street. Maintained security presence outside the 77 Convenience Store; observed an intoxicated homeless individual loitering nearby. No further incidents reported.
Continued foot patrol along Wellesley Street towards Queen Street; surrounding streets quiet with no incidents observed.
Returned to HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Ops Phone battery at 5%; commenced charging at HQ.
Remained at HQ awaiting the incoming shift for handover.
Night shift concluded; handover completed, equipment handed over and night shift personnel signed out.

flags: CAPACITY: 10:11 The Right Track response attended at 10:25 after the team continued welfare checks en route (Lorne/Wellesley and High Street); the individual had left before arrival.
SENSITIVE: 19:00 public report of minors attempting to fight an elderly individual at Bus Stop C, Lower Albert Street; no altercation found on arrival at 19:10.

capacity.note: Welfare checks completed en route; POI gone on arrival.
